name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Boone, Catfish, and Grayreach belong to different catches.
Wade goes with at least one of Crappie, Foxglen, or Pinehollow.
Royce, Pike, and Mossbank belong to different catches.
Wade goes with neither Pike nor Grayreach.
Crappie goes with neither Wade nor Mossbank.
